snippet.title: HOMS Marking Relief: Turn a Marking Batch into a Review Pack
snippet.description:
A marking batch is waiting. HOMS prepares the first structured pass so an educator can review the work instead of rebuilding the workflow from scratch.

The controlled pilot accepts learner scripts, a rubric or memo, and a marksheet. It prepares draft marks, feedback and review files with an explicit educator approval gate. The educator remains the final assessor.

Start with one fake, redacted or otherwise non-sensitive batch.
Contact: dio_workflows@outlook.com

Sources and further reading:
- DIO controlled HOMS three-script demonstration and educator review outputs.
- This video contains illustrative synthetic media; no real learner identity is represented.
